name: @ooo/web-overview
description: Canonical oorgos.org static overview. Edit here (/Users/kk/OOO/Web). Publish via Vercel from this directory, or sync back to Community/sites/coming-soon when needed.

scripts.build: npm run overview:links && node -e "console.log('Static site ready — deploy from /Users/kk/OOO/Web (canonical) or sync to Community/sites/coming-soon for Vercel')"
scripts.sync-to-community: rsync -a --delete --exclude node_modules --exclude dist --exclude .next --exclude tmp --exclude scratch --exclude test-results --exclude .env --exclude '.env.*' --exclude '*.pem' --exclude '*.key' --exclude _provisional-canvas-web --exclude package.json --exclude README.OOO.md --exclude .DS_Store ./ ../Community/sites/coming-soon/
